How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIT Warangal Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 26-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIT Warangal to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Warangal JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Warangal is 26 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. / MS. / Int. M.Sc. / BS-MS in Chemistry or an equivalent degree with the specified aggregate marks or CGPA.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the JRF post is 30 years, with relaxations available for OBC-NCL, SC, ST, PwD, and female candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a stipend of Rs. 37,000/- per month for the first two years and Rs. 42,000/- per month for the third year.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an interview, which can be conducted either online or offline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the JRF post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at NIT Warangal.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position is a contractual role at NIT Warangal.

faq.question: Q9. Where is NIT Warangal located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Warangal is located in Warangal, Telangana, with the pincode 506004.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Telangana apply for this position?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any domicile restrictions, so candidates from all eligible backgrounds can apply if they meet the criteria.
